text.p: These are some of the leading stories in the Bahraini press on Tuesday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- Contract to build the $5 million Bahrain Specialist Hospital is signed.
- Investors say the visit of Jordan's prime minister to Bahrain on Tuesday should give a boost to trade ties between the two countries.
- New business contracts between Bahraini and Jordanian businessmen amount to $6 million, the Bahrain Marketing and Promotion Board announces.
- An international expert urges Arabs to reap benefits of free trade.
- Expanison work at Bahrain's airport will be completed by the end of the year.
- There are 300 investment funds investing $2 billion in Bahrain, study says.
- Bahraini and Kuwaiti interior ministers discuss ways to boost security cooperation between the two countries.
